site.title: India's Economy as a Working Model
site.description: India's economy shown as money flowing between households, firms, banks, governments and the rest of the world, built from official statistics with every figure labelled by how it was made.

footer.attribution: Made by <link>Jitesh K Prasad</link> from official statistics. Sources and licences are listed on the methodology page.
footer.rechecked: Official figures re-checked against MoSPI on 18 Nov 2026: NAS 2026 is still the latest release
footer.fixture: Test data: this build uses generated fixture data, not real statistics.
